content: MoltenVK only surfaces its VkPhysicalDevice in vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices when VK_INSTANCE_CREATE_ENUMERATE_PORTABILITY_BIT_KHR is set at vkCreateInstance and the VK_KHR_portability_enumeration instance extension is enabled; the VK_KHR_portability_subset device extension must then be enabled if the physical device reports support for it. vk-bootstrap automates checking for and enabling both flags.
